The profile launcher and environment profile execute only from manifest-bound sealed captured bytes. The authoritative scientific parser executes from captured source-local bytes whose digest must equal the exact parser member in the clean-candidate source closure. Trusted trampoline completion anchors the exact expected receipt digest, immutable receipt-directory identities, original run root, inventory, and artifacts in the canonical mirrored ledger before publishing either paired external immutable receipt; recovery requires that pre-publication anchor and never reruns a zero-retry job. registered_case_contract.deck_rule: Read the exact checked-in case deck and deck manifest from the reviewed source root, compare deck bytes to the deterministic renderer, require the manifest digest cross-link, and require an immutable launch-deck copy with identical bytes under the registered artifact root.
registered_case_contract.execution_rule: Require runs/<campaign>/<submission-id> topology from the trusted pre-submit manifest, the exact bootstrapped paired installed producer generation and installed trampoline digest, a canonical mirrored-ledger trampoline_completion anchor created before paired receipt publication and followed by reconciliation, canonical Project Home per-submission receipt mirrors, trusted scheduler COMPLETED ExitCode=0:0, and exact trusted-manifest command and MPI resources.
registered_case_contract.stdout_terminal_rule: Require mandatory stdout/stderr identities and digests from the external ledger-anchored trampoline-completion receipt, exact trusted per-rank GPU launch lines, one exact aggregate rank-set line, one exact zero-exit line, cycle-one time/nlim evidence, cycle-limit termination, and scheduler COMPLETED ExitCode=0:0.
registered_case_contract.raw_inventory_rule: At Q043 reconciliation, open the trampoline-sealed artifact_inventory.json and every frozen artifact through no-follow retained descriptors, verify the complete frozen tree twice, exclude the trusted mutable analysis directory, derive an immutable SHA-256 raw inventory solely from sealed records, parse only exact retained bytes, and revalidate all descriptors, inventory bytes, namespace, and original run-root identity after analysis.

registered_case_contract.raw_oracle_rule: Scientifically validate every admitted cycle-zero deposited moment as finite and exactly zero, then recompute the source-local raw oracle from admitted cycle-one bytes; require exact case and matrix result schemas, exact provenance agreement, and launch_authorized=false, scientific_claim_authorized=false, publication_authorized=false, passed=false; record that source-local or synthetic analyzer success is insufficient.
